figures.shows: The yard at night: four shadowed lanterns, the sign lit by a spot light, one lantern swung out on its arm and the hut lit through its door by a ceiling panel
figures.caption: The finished yard. Each lantern has a pool of warm light and throws shadows away from itself, and the hut glows inside.
figures.alt: A night yard seen from the front. Warm pools of light lie on shiny ground under four lanterns, and one lantern hangs out on a bar from the front right post. The sign board on the left shines white in a patch of light. Dark shadows of the posts and the sign stretch away from the lamps, and a bright floor shows through the gap in the hut and is mirrored in the ground.

figures.shows: The yard under a 0.2 lux moon with the exposure set to +4 and no lamp
figures.caption: The moon alone, with the exposure raised by hand: the yard looks like a dull day, not a dark night, and nothing glows.
figures.alt: The yard under the moon at an Exposure of +4. The sky shows blue and the ground gray, as on a dull day. A box-shaped hut with a gap in its front wall, a sign board on a post, four thin posts and a bar on one post throw long, sharp shadows.

figures.shows: The yard with one 64 cd point light and a bulb above the first post, exposure +1
figures.caption: One lamp: a warm pool lies on the ground beneath it, and the yard beyond stays dark.
figures.alt: The dark yard with one small glowing ball above the front left post. A warm pool of light lies on the ground around the post and fades to dark at the edge of the lamp's range.

figures.shows: The yard with the lamp of the last section and the spot light on the sign board, its cone narrowed to 8 and 12 degrees
figures.caption: The narrowed spot light on the sign: a round patch, full in the middle and fading at its rim.
figures.alt: The night yard with one lamp above the front left post. A spot light makes a round white patch on the sign board, fading at its rim.

figures.shows: The four lanterns lit, each with a housing, a bulb and a point light, no shadows
figures.caption: Four lanterns from one design: one on each of three posts, one at the end of the arm.
figures.alt: The night yard with four lanterns, each a short gray cylinder with a glowing bulb on top and a warm pool of light under it. Three stand on posts and one hangs at the end of the bar on the front right post. The sign board shows its spot's white patch.

figures.shows: The four lanterns with shadows on and the housings out of the shadows
figures.caption: With shadows on, the hut, the sign and the posts throw shadows away from each lantern. The dark disc at a post's foot is its own shadow, cast by its top close under the bulb.
figures.alt: The night yard with four lanterns. The hut, the sign and the posts throw dark shadows away from the lanterns, and a dark disc lies at the foot of each lantern's post. The sign board shows its spot's white patch.

figures.shows: The lanterns over wet ground, each with a glint of its bulb
figures.caption: Wet ground mirrors each lantern as a soft glint, which its roughness spreads far wider than the bulb.
figures.alt: The night yard seen from higher up, over shiny wet ground. Each of the four lanterns shows a soft bright glint on the ground on the side toward the camera: two large ones in front, two smaller ones farther back. The sign board shows its spot's white patch.

figures.shows: The lantern on the arm turned a third of a turn from where it started
figures.caption: The arm has turned its lantern behind the post, and the post's long shadow now falls to the right.
figures.alt: The night yard with the arm on the front right post turned away from the camera, toward the hut. Its lantern hangs in a new place behind the post, and the long shadow of that post now falls to the right, toward the camera. The sign board shows its spot's white patch.

figures.shows: The Inspector with the lamp selected: its Point Light at the defaults, 10 cd and 10 m, with Cast Shadows off
figures.caption: The fields of a point light. The shadow fields stay gray until shadows are on.
figures.alt: The Inspector of a point light: a color box, an intensity of 10, a range of 10, a source radius of 0, an empty box for shadows and three grayed shadow fields.
